adjudication.rationale: The claim that `group_member.hbs` will always render the remove link because `automatic` resolves to `undefined` is not verifiable from the diff. The member rows are rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, and in Ember/Discourse itemView templates can still resolve properties from the parent controller/context; the diff does not show that `automatic` becomes inaccessible in the item view. The second point (422 rejection being “silently swallowed”) is also not directly supported by the diff: `removeMember` ultimately calls `Discourse.ajax(...)` and lacks an explicit failure handler, but whether that results in a silent failure depends on global/ajax error handling not shown here.
